_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Ranked list of resorts by fresh snow, depth, and SnowSure score

description: Get the global snow report with top-ranked resorts by snow conditions. Returns resorts sorted by SnowSure score, forecast, or recent snowfall. Use this for "where has the best snow?" or "top ski resorts right now" queries. Each row carries forecast7dCm and forecastHorizonDays; forecast14dCm is present only for a caller entitled to the fortnight (SnowSure Pro, or a resort in a signed-in reader's My Mountains), so read forecastHorizonDays before naming a forecast total.

limit.description: Number of resorts to return (default: 10, max: 50)

sort.description: Sort order: snowsure (AI rating), forecast (14-day snow), recent (24h snowfall), depth (current base)

name: get_snow_report

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary (required for ChatGPT Instant mode).

forecast14dCm.description: SnowSure blended forecast total (cm) over the forward 14 days. Present only when forecastHorizonDays is 14 — a caller entitled to the fortnight (SnowSure Pro, or a signed-in reader on a resort in their My Mountains). Absent or null for an anonymous or free caller: read forecast7dCm instead, and never label it a 14-day total.

forecast7dCm.description: SnowSure blended forecast total (cm) over the forward seven days, from the resort’s local today. The free window, served to every caller.

forecastHorizonDays.description: The forecast horizon this caller is entitled to: 14 with SnowSure Pro or on a resort in a signed-in reader’s My Mountains, 7 otherwise. Read it before naming any forecast total.

updatedAt.description: Oldest data time among the listed resorts (ISO-8601); null when none carries one. Never request time.

title: Global snow report
